notes: 「还原备份」改成和「立即拉取」同一条流水线，并升级为时点还原。以前点还原只会生成一个「同步-还原-xxx.cmd」，要自己退客户端、双击、输 y；现在点某份快照的「立即还原」会先弹确认框：面板向后台要一份差异预览，逐项列出将撤走几个快照之后装上的插件、将移走几个快照之后新增的文件、将覆盖/写回哪些文件、还原后要重装哪些插件，看清再点「确认还原」。确认后进入排队，客户端正常退出，post-exit.ps1 弹出可见进度窗口执行 restore.ps1 -RollbackToPoint，结果写回 auto-sync-result.json，然后自动重启客户端——整个过程和立即拉取一模一样，不用再碰命令行。时点还原的含义是回到那个时间点：配置按快照写回，快照之后新增的文件移进 backups\manual-<时间戳>\rollback\files，多装上的插件如果是 junction 只删链接（绝不穿进链接删掉实体目录）、实体目录移进 rollback\plugins，并写一份 rollback-manifest.json 记清每一项——全部可再还原，不做任何物理删除。面板同时调了显示：快照行加相对时间（3 分钟前 / 2 小时前）与插件数，卡片顶部显示上次还原的结果与日志路径，底部说明改成时点还原语义。另外修了一个只在短路径机器上出现的隐患：相对路径基准先用完整路径归一，避免 8.3 短名（ADMINI~1）把 profile 文件误判成新增文件搬走（隔离测试实测会把 package.json 一起搬走，已修并加了断言）。
notesEn: Restore now shares the same pipeline as Pull now and becomes a point-in-time restore. Previously clicking Restore only generated a "同步-还原-xxx.cmd" that you had to quit the client, double-click and answer y yourself. Now clicking "Restore now" on a snapshot first opens a confirmation: the panel asks the backend for a diff preview listing which plugins installed after that snapshot will be removed, which files created after it will be moved out, which files will be overwritten/written back, and which plugins will be re-installed afterwards. Only after you press "Confirm restore" does it queue: the client closes normally, post-exit.ps1 opens a visible progress window running restore.ps1 -RollbackToPoint, the result is written to auto-sync-result.json, and the client restarts automatically - exactly like Pull now, no command line needed. Point-in-time means rolling back to that moment: config is written back from the snapshot, files created afterwards move into backups\manual-<timestamp>\rollback\files, extra plugins are dropped by deleting the junction link only (never deleting through it into the real directory) or by moving the real directory into rollback\plugins, and every item is recorded in rollback-manifest.json - all of it can be restored again, nothing is physically deleted. The card also got clearer: each snapshot row shows a relative time (3 min ago / 2 h ago) and the plugin count, the card shows the last restore result plus its log path, and the footer now describes point-in-time semantics. One latent bug was fixed for machines using 8.3 short paths: relative paths are normalized against the full path first, so profile files are no longer misclassified as newly added and moved away (an isolated test actually moved package.json along with them; fixed, with assertions added).
